annotations.title: Plan, check and analyze a song

description: Plans and analyzes a song (render checks too); returns a share link that plays it in the browser (90 days, no render). Stages: plan, write, light analysis loop, one deep analysis, fix; then the share link to listen, or one render to embed. analyze:true: light; deep:true: measured. Schema 71227a86.

alts.description: Other MTL versions to rank by score

analyze.description: Light analysis: no audio, instant, free. Suited to every edit

compare.description: With analyze: A/B against an earlier songId, asset id or share link

compose.description: Instead of mtl: {bpm, form, chords, parts:[{id,gen}]}. describe(topic="generators")

deep.description: With analyze: deep analysis, a measured analysis-only render. Suited to once or twice when the song is nearly done

energy.description: Planned 1-5 per order entry, for check:true

genre.description: Scores against this genre's factors (each genre scores its own); describe(topic="genres")

keep.description: Kept on purpose, with a reason: flag codes {"POLY.CUT": "mono arp"} ("POLY.CUT:3" one track) or score codes (REPEAT, LEN...), not deducted

melody.description: Melody track, if not the highest

layers.description: With mtl: batch edits {add:["A: 3 i3 v40: C4 . . ."], replace, remove:["A:3"], instruments, mix, notes}; returns the edited song

mix.description: dB; "-inf" silences, 0 resets. Faders balance (first choice), gain sets one sound, level is overall loudness

notes.description: Polyphony: [{ch, ins, section?, notes:[[pitch, startBeat, beats, vel]]}]; placed on sub-channels; vel 0-64 as vNN

mtl.description: Song in MTL text (describe topic=mtl). Kept 2 hours as a working copy: later calls can send ref (the songId) instead.

plan.description: Alone: {bpm, meter, key, peak, sections:[{id, bars, energy 1-5, role}], mix?} gives a skeleton, timing, checks

range.description: With analyze: one section, e.g. "2" or "2-3" (order entries)

ref.description: Instead of mtl: a songId from an earlier reply (kept 2 hours), a render asset id, or a share link

name: song
title: Plan, check and analyze a song
